app.tagline: Find junk that's safe to remove. Nothing is deleted until you choose to.
clean.title: Clean up
clean.intro: Click Scan to see what can be cleaned. Scanning only looks — nothing is changed.
clean.appRunning: {0} is open — close it to clean this
clean.note: Selected items go to the Recycle Bin, so you can restore them.
clean.confirm.title: Move to Recycle Bin?
clean.confirm.body: {0} items ({1}) will be moved to the Recycle Bin. You can restore them from there until you empty it.
clean.done: Moved {0} items ({1}) to the Recycle Bin.
clean.doneSkipped: Moved {0} items ({1}) to the Recycle Bin. {2} were left alone because they changed, are in use, or their app is open.
cat.temp-files.name: Temporary files
cat.temp-files.desc: Files programs leave in your temp folder. Only items untouched for a day are listed; programs create new ones when they need them.
cat.crash-dumps.name: Crash dumps
cat.crash-dumps.desc: Memory snapshots saved when an app crashed. Only useful for investigating that crash.
cat.error-reports.name: Windows error reports
cat.error-reports.desc: Problem reports Windows collected about apps that stopped working. Already sent or no longer needed.
cat.edge-cache.name: Microsoft Edge cache
cat.edge-cache.desc: Pages and images Edge keeps to open sites faster. Rebuilt as you browse; your history, passwords and sign-ins are kept.
cat.chrome-cache.name: Google Chrome cache
cat.chrome-cache.desc: Pages and images Chrome keeps to open sites faster. Rebuilt as you browse; your history, passwords and sign-ins are kept.
cat.npm-cache.name: npm cache
cat.npm-cache.desc: Packages npm downloaded before. Downloaded again when a project needs them.
cat.pip-cache.name: pip cache
cat.pip-cache.desc: Python packages pip downloaded before. Downloaded again when needed.
cat.nuget-cache.name: NuGet HTTP cache
cat.nuget-cache.desc: Package lists and downloads NuGet cached. Your projects' installed packages are not touched.
cat.yarn-cache.name: Yarn cache
cat.yarn-cache.desc: Packages Yarn downloaded before. Downloaded again when a project needs them.
cat.gradle-cache.name: Gradle caches
cat.gradle-cache.desc: Dependencies and build caches Gradle downloaded (Android Studio). Downloaded again on the next build.
cat.download-installers.name: Installers in Downloads
cat.download-installers.desc: Setup files (.exe, .msi, .msix) you downloaded. Not selected by default — keep the ones you still need.
support.title: Support SweeplyForWindows
support.body1: SweeplyForWindows is free and always will be — no ads, no accounts, no data collection.
support.body2: If it saved you some space or some time, you can buy the developer a coffee: WeChat Pay or Alipay in China, PayPal anywhere. Every coffee keeps the project going. Thank you!
support.other: Not in a position to donate? A star on GitHub, a bug report or a translation fix helps just as much.
about.title: About
about.tagline: A small, honest junk cleaner for Windows.
about.privacy: Works offline: no network requests, no analytics, no accounts.
about.license: Open source under the MIT license.
about.issues: Report a problem or suggest an idea
about.translation: Translations other than English and Chinese would love a review from native speakers.
